candidate_measurement_definition: For each trabecula, source peak stress response at 10 ms and one candidate strain rate (100 or 250 s^-1).

comparators.C0: Training-set mean of the target, no candidate measurement.
comparators.C1: Nested-selected single global candidate rate across four targets within each outer fold.
comparators.C2: Nested-selected candidate rate separately for each target within each outer fold.
comparators.C3: Exact uniform random policy over all 2^4=16 candidate-rate assignments across the four targets, without outcome-informed selection; report full distribution and mean.
comparators.C4: Nearest strain-rate heuristic by absolute log10 rate distance between target rate and candidate rate; ties choose lower candidate rate; times are held at the frozen candidate/target times.
comparators.C5: Optimistic oracle: choose best candidate separately for each target using all seven subjects’ outer-LOTO errors, then summarize those same errors. Leakage by selection is intentional; descriptive upper bound only, never headline validation.

eligibility_rule: Include a trabecula only if all candidate and target conditions are observed for the outcome under analysis; primary-grid peak outcome has all 7 complete. No imputation.

eligible_perturbation_conditions.selection_rule: Coverage-only deterministic rule: 10 ms is the earliest time with at least two strain rates complete in all 7; 100 ms is the earliest later time with all four rates complete in all 7. No outcome metric informed condition choice.

failure_interpretation: No held-out C2 gain over C1 means no evidence that target-aware measurement selection improves this experiment even if descriptive candidate rankings vary. Improvement over baseline without improvement over C1 supports predictive value but not target-aware uplift. Unstable results are partial/boundary evidence. No claim of universal mechanism, causality, clinical or prospective prediction, or structural model adequacy.

falsifications.F1_target_label_permutation: Exhaust all 24 permutations of target-to-selector labels. In each outer fold, for actual target t apply the target-specific candidate chosen on the permuted label π(t), fit/predict the actual target t, and score against its held-out value; identity is the unpermuted procedure.
falsifications.F4_subject_leakage: Assert each outer test ID is excluded from all inner folds, candidate selection and model fitting; retain train/test IDs in prediction audit output.
falsifications.F5_exclusion_sensitivity: Repeat complete nested outer LOTO procedure after omitting each one of the seven subjects; report all six-subject results.
falsifications.F6_one_condition_dominance: Check if the same candidate rate wins the four target-specific outer-LOTO matrix cells and report winners by target; do not infer mechanism from it.

future_target_definition: For each trabecula, source peak stress response at 100 ms for each target strain rate (25, 100, 250, 1000 s^-1), evaluated separately.
missing_data_policy: Primary endpoint uses complete six-condition grid; zero excluded subjects. No imputation. Secondary endpoint is analyzed only if all 7 subjects have its candidate and target values; otherwise use the prespecified complete-subject subset and disclose N; no imputation.
model_family: Ordinary affine univariate least-squares regression with intercept. If candidate variance is zero in a training fold, slope=0 and intercept=training target mean. No scaling or feature engineering.

nested_selection.global_C1: Choose one candidate rate minimizing the equally weighted mean of the four target-specific inner MAEs; exact ties choose lower strain rate; use same rate for all four targets in this outer fold; refit each target model on all six outer-training subjects.
nested_selection.inner_resampling: Leave-one-trabecula-out among the six outer-training subjects.
nested_selection.inner_score: Mean absolute error per candidate × target, equally weighted across held-out inner subjects.
nested_selection.target_specific_C2: For each target, choose candidate rate with lower inner MAE; exact ties choose lower strain rate; refit affine OLS on all six outer-training subjects.

outer_holdout_unit: Leave-one-trabecula-out (LOTO); all rows from held-out trabecula excluded from fitting and every selection decision.
primary_endpoint: Aggregate outer-LOTO MAE across seven subjects × four targets. Compare C2 with C0 and C1. Report MAE, RMSE, median absolute error, paired absolute-error differences, fraction of subject-target cells improved, and target-wise results.

primary_outcome_family.definition: Same scalar peak stress response at candidate and future target condition; figure panel Fig. 3A identifies mN/mm^2, but the workbook column header omits the unit.
primary_outcome_family.name: peak_stress_response
primary_outcome_family.why_primary: Complete across all source subject-condition records and all six frozen conditions; consistent biological definition; direct mechanical magnitude; no exclusions; outcome choice made by availability and interpretability before predictive results.

randomness_policy: C3 is exact enumeration, not Monte Carlo. Bootstrap uses NumPy Generator(PCG64), seed 20261003, 10,000 subject-cluster resamples. F1 uses exact 24 permutations.
scientific_scope: Independent retrospective subject-held-out empirical replication/generalization in an intact-cardiac-trabecula stretch perturbation dataset.
secondary_metrics: subject-clustered bootstrap percentile interval for paired C2−C1 and C2−C0 MAE differences (10,000 resamples; descriptive only)
NRMSE only if denominator is defensible; do not make it primary
success_interpretation: Evidence of target-aware predictive value requires C2 outer-LOTO MAE below C1 and C0, with subject-level gains not driven by a single trabecula, and target-specific ranking variation. Interpret strength using effect sizes, every subject, exact selection audit and leave-one-subject-out aggregate sensitivity; n=7 precludes claims based on asymptotic significance.
target_candidate_eligibility_thresholds: A primary condition must be observed for all seven independent trabeculae; minimum target/candidate grid is two candidates and two future targets. The frozen primary grid has two candidates and four targets.
